title: Woman Goes Nuts After Police Stop Her From Committing A Crime

#cops #police #arrest

On June 22nd, 2023.  An officer was called to a bar about a woman who had consumed a lethal amount of alcohol about to hop in a car and drive. When the officer approached her, he could immediately smell the alcohol coming from her breath, then the lady started acting erratic and even took off running from the officer.  This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
